name: Righteous Fury's Fierce Block: Fierce Blows are blocked 1.6 times as often (PRs #275, #279)
contract: With Righteous Fury (25780, linked companion 986051: 6000) and a shield, the chance to block a Fierce Blow is multiplied by 1.6 (James, 25 Nov 2026). A dummy casts Tank Dummy Fierce Blow (2180275, one of the 44 Fierce Blow ids) at the paladin 800 times without and 800 times with Righteous Fury; block chance is raised to about 30% by a fixture aura so the change is measurable. Expected ratio of blocked strikes 1.6; the bounds 1.35-1.9 hold for 800 strikes each at about 3 standard deviations, and exclude both no effect (1.0) and the old flat +60 points (about 3).
